value.rationale: Prime-power value sets of integral polynomials are a natural number-theoretic invariant. The polynomial x^p-px is a canonical Frobenius-minus-linear deformation whose reduction permutes F_p but whose derivative vanishes modulo p. The infinite exact classification, explicit critical square cylinders, exceptional cubic stabilization and different rational densities reveal structural behavior inaccessible from only mod-p data or global estimates.
